quotes.author: Tim Rozansky
quotes.text: Tim Rozansky6 years agoWe decided to take the kids crabbing at the last minute and went to Mike’s because of the reviews.He was very helpful with where to go and had most everything you would need. There were no crab nets left!! He said they are sold out everywhere! Guess what he did? He said take his and leave it at the dock when you are done!!He also recommended to go to Motts which was awesome.I will definitely stop in again.

quotes.author: Sciarrino’s Pizza
quotes.text: Sciarrino’s Pizza6 years agoWe were little skeptical about the renting a boat but it was smooth and had a great experience and fun time fishing. Got one keeper Flounder.Also The girl (sorry didn’t get her name) that prep the boat was really friendly and did her job very efficiently.Will do another for our company outing and rent a pontoon. Can’t wait!

quotes.author: James Louder
quotes.text: James Louder4 years agoI grew up going to Cap Mike's I am 61 I have not been there for about 30 years I always went with Dad and his friends and there son's.i have so many memories from Capt Mike's. I hope to get back this year.but I am going through a rough time right now. Best place

quotes.author: Armen Avetisian
quotes.text: Armen Avetisian5 years agoI never go anywhere else to rent a boat to go fishing for the day. Nobody beats the prices, my favorite place to go fishing is Great Bay and Captain Mike's is also the only Marina that rents boats there. The owner Tim is the man and always super helpful.

quotes.author: Ryan Dowling
quotes.text: Ryan Dowling4 years agoGreat spot to launch, quick ride to the inlet. Gentleman behind the counter (Mike I'm assuming) helped us navigate the channels out to the inlet. Very much appreciated. Fair price to launch, 20$. Ramps are in great condition, easy at high and low tides. A+
